summary: 周六。dankrad 批评 EF Mandate 让基金会回到只做密码朋克的老路。decentrek 表示，参与 EIP-8141 的 ACD 流程后，他也感到客户端开发者与以太坊的真实使用有些脱节。SirSpudlington 提议把 EIP-8141 的 EOA 默认代码迁移到 EIP-7932 签名算法注册表。

EIP-8141 default code moves to the EIP-7932 registry
summary_en: A Saturday. dankrad criticized the EF Mandate as the foundation returning to building only cypherpunk things. decentrek said that after working through ACD on EIP-8141 he also feels client developers are somewhat detached from real Ethereum usage. SirSpudlington proposed moving EIP-8141's EOA default code to the EIP-7932 signature algorithm registry.
